evidence.Medial Meniscus: Tear of posterior horn of left medial meniscus.
evidence.PF OA: Osteoarthritis of left knee with grade 3-4 chondromalacia of patellofemoral joint.
evidence.Effusion: Joint effusion with mildly increased signal on T1WI
evidence.Synovitis: Synovitis of left knee joint with suprapetellar bursitis.
